notes.title: Ver. 1.0.1 Update is Now Available!
notes.content:
Thank you for purchasing "Steam Prison -Beyond the Steam-."
A Ver. 1.0.1 patch which resolves some known issues is now available.

We apologize for any inconvenience our customers may have experienced.
Your cooperation in installing this new patch is greatly appreciated.

[i]*If you have an active network connection, your software will be automatically updated.[/i]

Patch Notes
[b]■Version 1.0.1 (April 10, 2025)[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where performing certain actions on the MANUAL screen causes the game to become unplayable.
[*]Updated Simple Chinese and Traditional Chinese translations of the game text and UI.
[*]Fixed typos in certain portions of the UI.
[*] Other minor bug fixes.
[/list]
